body: @rsvoboda can you try doing the same thing with a sample `vertx-web` application?

```
mvn clean package -f app-jax-rs-minimal -Dquarkus.version=2.4.0.Final
du -cskh app-jax-rs-minimal/target/quarkus-app
find app-jax-rs-minimal/target/quarkus-app | grep "jar$" | wc -l

mvn clean package -f app-jax-rs-minimal -Dquarkus.version=2.2.3.Final
du -cskh app-jax-rs-minimal/target/quarkus-app
find app-jax-rs-minimal/target/quarkus-app | grep "jar$" | wc -l
```
with `quarkus-vertx-web` gives
```
 28M	app-jax-rs-minimal/target/quarkus-app
 28M	total
     111

 28M	app-jax-rs-minimal/target/quarkus-app
 28M	total
     108
```

So only small diff in number of jars with `quarkus-vertx-web` 

As stated in description, I see more com.fasterxml.jackson.* and io.smallrye.reactive.* artifacts in 2.4.0.Final.
I have attached the list of artifacts too.

Direct comparison - https://www.diffchecker.com/fBNicRlQ (will be available for 1 month)

Jackson Databind is now brought in because of https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/19933 (cc @mkouba @cescoffier) but FWIW, it does **not** affect the runtime in `main` (after the inclusion of https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/20833) unless used explicitly

Maybe we should remove the `quarkus-jackson` dependency from the `quarkus-vertx` extension. Because if I understand https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/16797#issuecomment-828966581 correctly, it should not be needed anymore...
Yes, Vert.x should not be depending hardly on Jackson databind. Can you remove `quarkus-jackson` so we can see what CI says?
Hm, we would have to get rid of https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/tree/main/extensions/vertx/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/vertx/runtime/jackson. Do you have an idea what are these classes for?
Those classes are used conditionally IIRC.
